# Grid

## Purpose
The board's grid as data: every cell and what occupies it, and the questions asked of them - which cell a world point is in, whether an area is free, where the nearest free area is, how to keep an area on the grid. A Service: it knows no building or unit, and whoever places something on the grid calls it directly.

## Concepts
grid, cell, CellVO, occupancy, occupant, free area, IsAreaFree, FindFreeArea, WorldToCell, IGridService, RD_Grid
